# Ollama 0.34.2 currentness corpus

This secret-free identity corpus freezes official GitHub `v0.33.3` through
`v0.34.2` against the `0.33.2` claim before Swallowtail moves the
`ollama.runtime` native attached ceiling. Host `ollama` was not installed.
Official app archives were not downloaded. The frozen `0.32.14`, `0.32.15`,
and `0.34.0` corpora stay.

Seven of the eight selected structs (`ChatRequest`, `ChatResponse`,
`Message`, `ListResponse`, `ProcessResponse`, `ShowRequest`,
`ShowResponse`) are byte-identical from `v0.33.2` through `v0.34.2`.
`Options` changes only by a `typical_p` deprecation comment at `v0.34.1`;
`Runner.NumCtx` is byte-identical. The five selected routes stay registered
at every hop. `ShowHandler` and `PsHandler` are byte-identical across the
window.

Research 313 named the `0.33.3` `prompt_eval_cached_count` stop and a
decoder-tolerance follow-up. This record is that follow-up: accept and
ignore the additive metrics key, then qualify `0.33.3` through official
`0.34.2` as a compatible extension of `ollama.native-text-v1`. Remaining
`0.34.0`–`0.34.2` deltas stay bounded unmapped (tags cache removal,
capability-consistency fill of ignored fields, `getModel` rename,
safetensors helper rename on the rejected non-gguf show path, desktop/CLI
setup, MLX/llama.cpp). GitHub still marks plain `v0.32.2` and `v0.32.10`
as prereleases. Those stay named exclusions. `v0.34.3-rc1` is ignored.

No fixture contains a credential, host path, account identity, provider
payload, real model observation, or live inference response.
